gold: Type I cryoglobulinemia associated with multiple myeloma

selector.rationale: Hypercalcemia, abnormal paraprotein band, and monoclonal IgG-κ protein support Multiple Myeloma, while bone marrow biopsy showing 80% plasma cells with κ-light-chain restriction confirms the diagnosis

rejected.label: Waldenström macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: Hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells and κ-light-chain restriction is not typical for Waldenström macroglobulinemia

rejected.label: Plasma cell leukemia
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings supporting plasma cell leukemia, such as high levels of plasma cells in the peripheral blood

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Skin sloughing is not specific for amyloidosis, and other findings do not support this diagnosis
